# Research

From complex data to useful knowledge. My work explores artificial intelligence and data analytics, with applications in health, enterprise systems, and environmental prediction.
:::

## Research interests

Themes reflected in my publications and collaborative projects.

::: {.research-grid}
::: {.research-card}
[01]{.card-number}

### Artificial intelligence

Large language models, applied AI, and the challenges of bringing intelligent systems into real settings.

[LLMs · Enterprise systems]{.card-tags}
:::

::: {.research-card}
[02]{.card-number}

### Data & predictive analytics

Learning from data to support prediction and decision-making, including research on weather and sports.

[Deep learning · Prediction]{.card-tags}
:::

::: {.research-card}

### AI security & applications

Collaborative work on vulnerabilities in AI systems, alongside applications of AI in disease detection.
